results.title: Border Diaries
results.overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

results.title: Who We Are
results.overview: Camille Decourtye and Blaï Mateu Trias are heads of Baro d’evel, a celebrated French performing arts company. When the Festival d’Avignon commissions a new piece from them, they feel the need to find a renewed sense to their existence as artists, partners and parents

results.title: A Very Southern Church
results.overview: A modern, young pastor from NYC becomes the new lead pastor of a small traditional church in the Deep South, where his will to fit in is crushed by the opposing world views of the people he meets.

results.title: Fivehead
results.overview: After a caricature drawing exaggerates the size of her forehead, Eve spirals and takes extreme measures to "fix" herself.

results.title: Mehr als 90 Minuten - Die Menschen der WM 2026
results.original_title: Mehr als 90 Minuten - Die Menschen der WM 2026
results.overview: A retrospective of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in Mexico, Canada and the United States, exploring the drama, emotion and unforgettable moments of a tournament of superlatives through the people who experienced it.

results.title: Lira
results.overview: After a few months in a spaceship headed to earth, Eva finds out that her husband lied about the destination of their trip. She tries to change the route back to earth but can't, so she has to continue to live on a spaceship with a man she no longer trusts.

results.title: Pickleball Pete
results.overview: A washed-up tennis player enters a Palm Beach pickleball tournament in order to save his hometown courts from being torn down for a corporate office complex.

results.title: Broken
results.overview: After tragedy comes back to haunt her, a young woman named Nancy struggles to rebuild a connection with her family and friends amidst a Serial Killer stalking the streets of Cleveland. Will she be the next victim or will the Detectives investigating the case solve the Murders before it's too late?

results.title: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass
results.original_title: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass
results.overview: For over fifty years, the disappearance of Paul McCartney’s original Höfner bass has been one of rock ‘n’ roll’s enduring mysteries. The Hunt for the Lost Bass tells the extraordinary story of this iconic instrument, and the fan powered quest to find it.

results.title: Of Swallows
results.overview: A swallow’s eye is longer than other birds. Their visual acuity is said to resemble Raptors. For sailors, swallows are a good omen signifying a close shore. My father loved birds. Since his passing I've felt afloat. Lost and unanchored. At sea in overwhelming emotions. I close my eyes and look for swallows, as metaphorical groundings.

results.title: Translation
results.overview: A young Gaeilgeoir must learn the art of self-assurance and acceptance upon moving from her remote town to the city.

results.title: Mentua Pujaan
results.overview: Irfan seeks a way to soften the heart of his fierce father-in-law for a peaceful celebration.

results.title: Mihnea
results.overview: The only son of a tight-knit Romanian-Canadian family struggles with his mental health and the expectations of his authoritarian father in his final year of University.

results.title: Milton Jones: Ha!Milton
results.overview: This is not a musical. Milton Jones is tone deaf and has no sense of rhythm, but at least he doesn’t make a song and dance about it.  He has more important things to discuss. Like giraffes…and there’s a bit about tomatoes.  You might know him from Mock the Week, Live at the Apollo or Radio 4. Or that time he stood for the Scottish National Party, fought a hard campaign, but in the end had to respect the wishes of the people of Cardiff.  A whole new show of daftness. You know it makes sense.

results.title: Cape Farewell
results.overview: Fresh out of prison, Toni struggles to reconnect with her daughter Anna, who was raised by her grandmother Betty, while resisting the  pull of her ex-lover Max's criminal world. Working at her uncle  Frank's restaurant, she discovers his smuggling ties and Max involves her in a violent altercation on the docks. She faces pressure  from the police and seeks redemption by getting away from Max.  But trouble catches up with her, putting her family in danger. Toni will take all the risks to finally find a chance for her future with Anna and Betty.

results.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
results.overview: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

results.title: Tales of Ardenmore
results.overview: A brash knight-in-training must partner with the woman he spurned, on a quest to save his brother from an undead sorcerer. Together they must overcome rogue warriors, monsters and magic.

results.title: Blue Sands
results.overview: In a neon-drenched dystopia where lifespans are traded like currency, a dying man drags himself through the night in search of a second chance he may not deserve.
